ears.label: EARS (with local Whisper as fallback when Groq fails): any language, auto-detected by Groq Whisper (no language hint). Needs groq_api_key.
EARS: English, fully local (SenseVoice int8 via sherpa-onnx). Free, no key, no internet, ~1 s per sentence.
EARS (with local Whisper as fallback when Groq fails): Dutch (or any language), cloud: Groq Whisper large-v3-turbo. Free tier, needs groq_api_key.

brains.label: BRAIN: Cerebras (OpenAI-compatible endpoint), model gpt-oss-120b, the same model as the Groq brain but on Cerebras' own very fast chips.
BRAIN: Claude Haiku 5.5 (Anthropic), through Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint. PAID: about $0.10 per million input and $0.50 per million output tokens
BRAIN: Google Gemini, model gemini-3.5-flash-lite (tested ~0.6 s, good Dutch, tool calls work). Free tier via Google AI Studio.
BRAIN: Groq (OpenAI-compatible endpoint), model openai/gpt-oss-120b. Free tier, fast (~0.5 s). Needs groq_api_key.

voices.label: VOICE: Edge (Microsoft, needs internet), Dutch. Replies in Dutch; the spoken "sorry" and goodbye lines are Dutch. Starts with the voice Maarten (pick any voice in the Voice card).
VOICE: Edge (Microsoft, needs internet), English. Replies in English; the spoken "sorry" and goodbye lines are English. Starts with the British voice Ryan (pick any voice in the Voice card).
VOICE: Dutch, local Piper (free, no internet, ~0.3 s per sentence). Replies in Dutch. Starts with the female voice Nathalie (Flemish); others: Pim and Ronnie (male), pick any in the Voice card.
VOICE: English, local Piper (free, no internet, ~0.3 s per sentence). Replies in English. Starts with the British male Alan.

params.label: Language hint
params.hint: nl, en ... (empty = auto-detect)

params.label: Cloud model
params.hint: only for cloud ears, e.g. whisper-large-v3-turbo

params.label: Speech threshold
params.hint: 0.1-0.9, higher = ignores more noise

params.label: Low threshold
params.hint: 0.1-0.9, end-of-speech sensitivity

params.label: End-of-speech pause (ms)
params.hint: longer = waits more before answering

params.label: Vision model (camera)
params.hint: the model that looks at photos; must accept images

params.label: Model name
params.hint: the models your key can use; changes when you pick another Brain above

params.label: Briefing topics
params.hint: what the daily briefing ("good morning") looks for in the news, plus the weather; e.g. world news, technology, sports. Empty = general top news

params.label: Instant commands
params.hint: on: short commands (stop, volume, time, timers, moves, moods, explore, briefing) are done before the brain: instant, no tokens, work with no brain at all

params.label: Memory
params.hint: on: Jarvis keeps short notes about the people it talks to (a file on this PC, see the Memory card); off: it forgets everything after each conversation

params.label: Fallback brain
params.hint: answers when the main brain fails (quota used up, overloaded, too slow); auto = the other brain whose key is set

params.label: Music folder
params.hint: the folder with your songs (mp3, m4a, flac ...), sub-folders are searched too: music = the music folder in this project, or a full path, e.g. C:\jarvis\music Empty = no music

params.label: Seconds per song
params.hint: how much of a song is played (10-180)

params.label: Radio and podcasts stop after (minutes)
params.hint: 0 = an internet radio station or podcast plays until you stop it (voice, landing page, app or panel); a number of minutes adds a timer

params.label: Radio: home country
params.hint: two-letter country code (NL, BE, DE, GB, US ...): stations of this country come first when you ask for "jazz radio" or a name several stations share

params.label: Start in the song
params.hint: auto = from 20% into the song (past the intro), 0 = from the start, or a number of seconds

params.label: Home Assistant: done at once
params.hint: kinds of Home Assistant things Jarvis may switch straight away, comma separated (light, switch, fan, scene, script, climate, input_boolean ...)

params.label: Home Assistant: ask first
params.hint: kinds Jarvis only does after you say yes (cover = blinds and curtains). Anything not listed in either box is refused

params.label: Temperature
params.hint: 0 = factual, 1 = creative

params.label: Max answer length (tokens)
params.hint: short answers are faster to speak

params.label: Voice
params.hint: e.g. en-GB-RyanNeural, nl-NL-MaartenNeural

params.label: Reply language
params.hint: the language the brain is told to answer in (English, Dutch ...); must match the voice

params.label: Speaking speed (%)
params.hint: -50 slower ... +50 faster

params.label: Log detail
params.hint: INFO, or DEBUG to see every message in the debug console

params.label: Search level
params.hint: basic = fast, 1 Tavily credit per search; advanced = deeper and slower, 2 credits

params.label: Regions to search
params.hint: one search per region, run together; more regions = more credits

params.label: Results per search
params.hint: more results = more tokens for the brain

params.label: Hang up after silence (s)
params.hint: conversation ends after this long

params.label: Personality / instructions
params.hint: the system prompt of the brain
params.value: Your name is Jarvis. You are friendly, curious and a little dry-humoured, like a helpful butler who is also a bit of a gadget.
